description: January 29 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 29 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the first decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Uranus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: January 29 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Twenty-nine holds as master number 11 rather than reducing to 2, and on January 29 it lands in the closing degree of Aquarius's Uranus decan, about nine degrees in. Intuition and invention combine strongly here. The tradition paints a visionary nervous system: someone who senses trends early, though they may need grounding routines to stay steady.

On January 29 the Sun usually sits at about 9° Aquarius, in the first decan, where Uranus rules the decan as well as the sign. Uranus, the modern ruler of Aquarius, also governs its opening decan, from about January 21 to January 29. This is traditionally the most independent and inventive part of the sign. Late-January birthdays are commonly linked with original thinkers, interested in the future, technology, social change and the freedom to be exactly themselves. Friendship tends to matter as much as romance, sometimes more. Doubled Uranus can bring a contrarian streak and an emotional detachment that others misread as coldness. Their gift is seeing possibilities ahead of the crowd and inviting others along without pressure.

sections.heading: January 29 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one January 29 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 2 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example.

sections.heading: Born on January 29: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 29 is the 29th day of the year. By February 19, 21 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, January 29 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 35 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on January 29 include Anton Chekhov (1860), William McKinley (1843) and Romain Rolland (1866).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 29?
faq.answer: January 29 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Uranus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 29 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 2 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 29?
faq.answer: January 29 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 35 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 29?
faq.answer: January 29 is also the birthday of Anton Chekhov (1860), William McKinley (1843) and Romain Rolland (1866). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
